question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**conflict**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence refers to challenges faced by healthcare workers in balancing their professional and personal lives.
 
• The phrase "work-family conflict" is a well-established term that describes this struggle.
 
• "**Conflict**" fits logically and grammatically, indicating tension or opposition between work duties and family responsibilities.
 
• Other options like "**addict**", "**inflict**", and "**evict**" do not make sense in this context or grammatically fit the structure.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Reducing the hours worked and optimising shift rostering could (1) help__ alleviate stress, burnout and work family (2) __conflict__ for healthcare workers. All this is likely to improve staff retention. Any reduction (3) **________**staff turnaround would save on direct costs associated (4) **_________**hiring new staff. The cost to replace a highly specialised healthcare professional can reach up to 200% of their annual salary. Also, (5) **_________**shorter shifts may increase the uptake of shift times that are usually hard to fill. Measures like shorter shifts could also appeal to part time workers or those who have retired.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Addict: A person who is dependent on a substance or activity—does not fit the context.
 
• Inflict: A verb meaning to cause harm—does not grammatically or contextually fit here.
 
• Evict: A verb meaning to expel someone from property—completely unrelated to the context.
